headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 12, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the offense and Sandy Alcantara dominating on the mound. Hicks hit 3 home runs, including a 2-run shot, while Alcantara pitched 8 strong innings with 7 strikeouts.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Evan Carter has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Texas Rangers due to a right oblique strain. The Pittsburgh Pirates have also placed Wilber Dotel on the 15-day injured list with a right lat muscle strain. Other teams have suffered similar losses, including the Detroit Tigers (Jack Flaherty), San Diego Padres (Miguel Andujar), New York Yankees (Trent Grisham), Atlanta Braves (Spencer Strider), Milwaukee Brewers (Coleman Crow), and Colorado Rockies (Chase Dollander).

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable deals taking place. The Chicago White Sox acquired Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for Future Considerations. The White Sox also traded Derek Hill and Other Considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for Dylan Campbell and Jose Colmenares. Additionally, the Milwaukee Brewers traded Jacob Waguespack to the Detroit Tigers.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured an 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the offense and Sandy Alcantara dominating on the mound. Hicks hit 3 home runs, including a 2-run shot, while Alcantara pitched 8 strong innings with 7 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Nationals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory. Bryce Miller led the way for the Mariners, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Orioles in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Gunnar Henderson leading the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. Shane Baz earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to Guardians in Close Contest**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians in a closely contested game. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Twins 9-6**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera and Jordan Walker leading the charge for the Cardinals. Impact hitters for the Twins included Byron Buxton and Royce Lewis.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 3-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Cam Schlittler and Kevin Gausman leading the way for the winning team. Jasson Domínguez and Paul Goldschmidt were among the impact hitters in the game.

top_news.title: **Rangers CF Evan Carter Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Evan Carter has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
